senses.gloss: m. (v. דְּכַר) = h. זָכוּר, remembered, reminded, mindful.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 103:14">Targ. Ps. CIII, 14</cite> <he>ד׳ קדמוי</he> it is remembered before Him.—
<cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 9:15">Targ. Gen. IX, 15</cite> <he>דְּכִירְנָא</he> I shall remember; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Taanit 20b:11">Taan. 20ᵇ</cite> <he>בינקותיה לא דכירנא</he> I do not remember his young days.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 5:15">Targ. Y. Deut. V, 15</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Lamentations 1:7">Targ. Lam. I, 7</cite>.
